review_notes: Both cola are construct chains the ASV renders attributively rather than with *of*, so rule 28 governs and no relational word is placed (rule 19's *of* is not written).
No article morpheme stands in either phrase and the ASV writes no determiner, so rules 15 and 29 raise nothing to count.
